english.note: Use 發夢 as the all-purpose verb for dreaming in sleep, and also for casual unrealistic daydreaming.

examples.english: I had a dream last night that I won the Mark Six.
examples.traditional: 我琴晚發夢，夢見自己中咗六合彩。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 kam4 maan5 faat3 mung6 mung6 gin3 zi6 gei2 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2

english.note: This is the casual all-purpose choice for drifting into thoughts or failing to pay attention.

examples.english: I often daydream during meetings and miss a few things.
examples.traditional: 我開會嗰陣成日發夢，聽漏咗幾句。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 faat3 mung6 teng1 lau6 zo2 gei2 geoi3
